overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Trinity 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna combines 6 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels with 2 Near IR Elements, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized spa experience. Ideal for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, this sauna is a perfect addition to your wellness routine.
